purpose: Replace YouTube embed iframes with lightweight static thumbnail placeholders that load the real player on user click, reducing page weight and improving LCP.
riskRationale: All 9 reported issues from the initial review have been fixed (critical orphaned </iframe> tag, noscript CSS fallback, accessibility gaps, type consistency, double-execution guard). One remaining edge-case issue: the iframe error handler on network failure modifies a detached DOM element and is unreliable for cross-origin embeds. This does not affect the common-case behavior.
breakingChanges: Removes the unused lazyLoadIframes code path from enqueue script logic

text: Clean, functionally correct implementation that integrates YouTube placeholder replacement into the existing image optimisation pipeline. All blocking issues from the initial review have been resolved. One edge-case issue remains in the error handler for iframe network failures.

reasoning: All critical and important blocking issues from the initial review have been addressed. The single remaining issue is the iframe onerror handler acting on a detached DOM element, which only affects the edge case of a network failure on cross-origin embeds and does not block core functionality.

message: Clean, focused regex for YouTube URL matching that correctly handles youtube.com, youtube-nocookie.com, and youtu.be variants.
generate_video_placeholder() provides 3 WordPress filters (wppo_video_placeholder_allowed, wppo_video_play_button_html, wppo_video_placeholder_html) for extensibility.
YouTube placeholder replacement is inserted before the generic lazy-load pass, preventing duplicate processing and correctly falling through for non-YouTube iframes.
enable_video_placeholder is correctly gated on lazy_load_videos, preventing the feature from loading when video lazy loading is off — consistent with the UI nesting.
Good UX: the Video Placeholder toggle only appears when Video Lazy Loading is enabled, using a nested field pattern.
Self-guarding init with el.dataset.wppoInit prevents double-binding, supports click and keyboard (Enter/Space) with preventDefault (WCAG 2.1.1), and the wppoLoaded guard prevents double-execution.
Clean responsive SCSS with aspect-ratio, hover scale effect, and focus-visible keyboard outline.

The iframe.onerror handler modifies el.style.display and deletes el.dataset.wppoLoaded, but el (the placeholder div) has already been removed from the DOM by el.parentNode.replaceChild(iframe, el). Since onerror fires asynchronously, it modifies a detached DOM element with no visible effect. Additionally, the iframe error event is unreliable for cross-origin embeds (YouTube) — most browsers do not fire it for cross-origin load failures. The user sees a broken/blank iframe on network failure with no fallback UI or retry mechanism.
suggestion: Move the error handler setup before replaceChild and re-insert the original placeholder into the parent node in the callback. Since onerror is unreliable for cross-origin iframes, add a fallback timer (e.g., 20s timeout) using iframe.onload.
